contract.title: D1 dynamic link rate round-4 cold-start review (commit 2e88099)
contract.goal: Review exact commit 2e88099 on branch codex/20260819-d1-dynamic-rate (merged with latest main incl. #28 lazy activation). Re-check the round-3 REQUEST_CHANGES findings: (F1) UplinkServer._pick retiring branch must NOT bypass geometry/GE/MCS-rate availability gates -- a gated head must stay queued and the shared server must serve other endpoints; verify the fix and its regression test (retiring gated head stays queued while B is served). (F2-A) deadline sweeps (_sweep_endpoint_queue, _sweep_downlink_queues) must use now>=deadline so a packet whose deadline equals the certified GSL wake time expires exactly at the deadline, not one time_step later; pre-dequeue GE gates in _pick/_servable must count toward ge_gsl_queries so receipt effective.ge is not falsely false. Verify the two queue-gating tests no longer have false positives (active link established before the gate). Also confirm legacy RF/MCS equivalence, zero-rate/geometry-loss/GE-down queue and service semantics for shared uplink/downlink/ISL, snapshot residual-service accounting, legal masks, counters/receipt, deadline/retirement/GE-geometry races, and regression test adequacy. Return APPROVE or REQUEST_CHANGES with FACT/INFERENCE/UNVERIFIED, exact path/line evidence, concrete reproduction conditions, severity and open_items. Do not modify code.
acceptance: Explicit re-check of round-3 F1/F2-A with line evidence
Every major finding has exact evidence and reproduction condition
requiredEvidence: Exact commit-bound GitHub paths and line references
Explicit verdict that retiring uplink gates match active gates
Explicit verdict on deadline inclusive sweep and ge_gsl_queries accounting
